description: What the relay checks of a post (docs/protocol.md §17). A post is nonce (8, big-endian) || envelope, and an envelope is version (1) || p (48) || tag (32) || c (48) || ciphertext. The relay keeps an envelope only if its version is 1, its length is one of sizes, and p and c (bytes 1-48 and 81-128) are each canonical compressed G1 points in the prime-order subgroup and not the identity, checked in that order; the tag (bytes 49-80) is any 32 bytes, and isn't checked. error names the first check that fails, or is null. digest = SHA-256(stamp_label || len(pool) (1 byte) || pool || envelope); a stamp's work is the leading zero bits of SHA-256(digest || nonce (8, big-endian)), and nonce is the first from 0 with at least bits. post is the post's first 8 bytes.
